Scenario fixture: rgaa-navigation-systems-review (RGAA 12.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form nsr_case_NN. The rule reads the whole page: it finds one navigation menu (case 01) and no site map link or search engine (the breadcrumb and the footer links do not count), so the page is asked about once.

01 — CANTTELL: the only menu of the page
  • Actualités
  • Démarches
  • Contact
02 — NOT A MENU: a breadcrumb
  1. Accueil
  2. Démarches
  3. État civil
03 — NOT A MENU: footer links
